zh.summary: 把金融顾问的会前准备、会中记录和会后文件接到现有客户系统的 AI 工作流。
zh.judgment: 机会在让既有系统真正连起来；能否降低复核与集成成本，比生成一份漂亮报告更关键。
zh.replaces: 顾问从多个系统整理会前资料，再手工整理会谈、撰写文件与回填 CRM。
zh.product: 浏览器核验的工作流连接客户准备资料、会谈记录、机构模板文档与 CRM 回写。官网说明 Xplan、intelliflo 等连接；支持范围与安全效果为公司声明，本次未登录实际执行业务。
zh.customer: 使用者包括顾问、辅助规划人员与运营团队；公司级采购可能由经营或合规负责人推动，此为场景推断。旧工作耗时有明确预算归属，但机构仍要确认节省的是总服务成本，而不是把劳动从顾问转移给复核人员。
zh.workflow: 会前聚合客户信息，会中捕获对话，会后形成文件并同步系统，是官网展示的主链路。分析上应抽查事实从原始会谈到最终文件是否一致，以及系统同步错误能否恢复；只展示成功案例不足以覆盖这些异常。
zh.business_model: 本次公开资料未确认统一价格、客户收入或毛利。机构合同与席位收费是可能形态；单位经济最敏感的部分可能是系统集成、模板适配和持续支持，必须看每家机构投入多少人工才进入常态使用。
zh.traction: 本次浏览器核验到 Navigate IFA 等顾问评价及明确的会前—会中—会后流程，均为公司页面资料。节省工时、资产覆盖和安全宣传未独立核验；不能把客户管理资产当作 PlannerPal 收入。
zh.moat: 替代品包括通用会议工具、机构自建自动化与原有系统内置 AI。潜在壁垒是嵌入既有服务流程的深度和机构知识的积累；接口覆盖越广并不必然越好，稳定同步与可解释的权限边界更重要。
zh.funding_read: 数据库把本轮归入未明确轮次，应保留原币与参与投资方，不猜成 A 轮或自动标注领投。商业里程碑可设为更多机构通过采购并持续扩席；融资金额本身没有证明增长效率、估值或跑道。
zh.risks: 一是输入陈旧或缺失会让文档看似完整却事实不一致。二是连接客户系统的权限与集成负担可能压低利润。三是机构原有平台补齐同类功能后，独立工具需要证明额外价值。
zh.takeaway: 可借鉴的是从客户服务周期设计产品，而不是从模型能力清单出发。先打通一个有明确交付责任的流程，再衡量总工时、出错率与组织续费，能避免只把局部自动化当作完整业务改善。
zh.watch_next: 看机构上线时间、每份报告复核时长、错误回填次数、付费席位扩展和净续费。还应核对不同系统组合的实施成本，确认规模增长没有同时放大不可复制的定制工作。

en.summary: An AI workflow connecting adviser preparation, conversations and follow-up documents to existing client systems.
en.judgment: The opportunity is connected execution; review and integration costs matter more than polished document generation.
en.replaces: Collecting preparation data across systems, then manually writing records and updating the CRM.
en.product: The browser-reviewed workflow joins client preparation, meeting capture, firm templates and CRM updates. Xplan and intelliflo integrations are described by the company; support scope and security were not independently tested.
en.customer: Advisers, paraplanners and operations staff use the workflow; operating or compliance leaders are plausible buyers. This is a workflow inference. Savings should be measured across the organisation rather than transferred from advisers to reviewers.
en.workflow: The stated sequence gathers client context, captures the conversation, creates outputs and updates records. Evaluation should trace facts through the final document and test recovery from incorrect synchronisation, including exceptional cases.
en.business_model: A standard price, revenue and gross margin were not confirmed here. Firm contracts or seats are possible models. Implementation, templates and ongoing support may dominate delivery economics, so manual effort per institution matters.
en.traction: Browser review confirmed adviser testimonials including Navigate IFA and a clear before/during/after workflow. Time savings, asset coverage and security claims were not independently verified; customer assets are not PlannerPal revenue.
en.moat: Alternatives include meeting tools, internal automation and incumbent platform AI. Deep workflow connections and institutional knowledge could help defend the product. Stable synchronisation and permissions matter more than the number of integrations.
en.funding_read: The database leaves the round unspecified. Preserve the original currency and investor list without guessing a Series A or lead investor. Procurement wins and sustained seat expansion would be useful commercial milestones.
en.risks: Outdated inputs may create complete-looking but inconsistent records. System permissions and integrations may reduce margins. Incumbent platforms could absorb enough functionality to weaken the case for a separate vendor.
en.takeaway: Design around a customer-service cycle rather than a model capability list. Start with an accountable deliverable and measure total labour, errors and renewals before claiming that local automation improves the whole business.
en.watch_next: Watch deployment time, review minutes, erroneous updates, paid-seat expansion and renewals. Compare implementation cost across system combinations to check that growth is not multiplying bespoke work.
